public.text: Reusing common actor sets may improve consistency, but national roles and scopes of practice vary significantly. Over-standardisation could obscure local legal and professional distinctions.
public.suggestedRevision: Define reusable base roles that countries can specialise through governed national role models, while preserving mappings to the common reference roles.
